bodies.line: All the tears and all the bodies
stanza: Tous les morts-nés forment une armée
Soon we will reclaim the earth
All the tears and all the bodies
Bring about our second birth

bodies.line: Lay the young blue bodies with the old red bodies
stanza: Venom radio and venom television
I'm afraid of everyone, I'm afraid of everyone
Lay the young blue bodies with the old red bodies
I'm afraid of everyone, I'm afraid of everyone

bodies.songTitle: Like Like the the the Death
bodies.line: Life finds a limit at the edge of our bodies
stanza: Nobody cares about a dead hooker
Looking like one, standing for many
Life finds a limit at the edge of our bodies
A stranger begins wherever I see 'em

bodies.line: Took six big wheels and rolled our bodies
stanza: Mmh, yes
Then I'd taken the kiss of seedcake back from his mouth
Going deep South, go down, mmh, yes
Took six big wheels and rolled our bodies
Off of Howth Head and into the flesh, mmh, yes

bodies.songTitle: Pagan Angel and a Borrowed Car
bodies.line: A bone cold and older than our bodies
stanza: Love was a promise made of smoke
In a frozen copse of trees
A bone cold and older than our bodies
Slowly floating in the sea
Every morning there were planes
The shiny blades of pagan angels in our father's skies
Every evening I would watch her hold the pillow
Tight against her hollows, her unholy child
I was still a beggar shaking out my stolen coat
Among the angry cemetery leaves
When they caught the king beneath the borrowed car
Righteous, drunk, and fumbling for the royal keys
Nameless bodies
In unremembered rooms
Know how a man becomes a beast
When the wolfbane blooms

bodies.songTitle: You Will. You? Will. You? Will. You? Will.
bodies.line: You said, "Go explore those other women, the geography of their bodies
stanza: Now I write when I'm away letters that you'll never read
You said, "Go explore those other women, the geography of their bodies
But there's just one map you'll need
You're a boomerang, you'll see
You will return to me
